title: dactylorhiza comosa subsp. occidentalis
intro: Dactylorhiza comosa subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Western marsh-orchid, is a subspecies of orchid native to the western parts of North America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza comosa subsp. occidentalis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating wounds, infections, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
